skill_metadata.skill_name: Enrich CBOM with Costing Sheet Data

isatvon_definition.i_instructions: Triggered by the Dify DMR's POST /tool/execute for skill_index 5 of Standard_BOM_Flow, after cbom has run. Action: require cbom_db.cbom rows to already exist for this rfq_id (hard ValueError otherwise); run enrichment.enrich_costing_sheet(con, rfq_id), which executes UPDATE statements (queries.costing_enrichment_sql) to fill _costing columns on existing cbom rows from the input_db.costing_sheet table. Check: transaction commits only if no exception is raised. Bound: single attempt, no retry loop. Business rule: independent of enrich_erp -- either order, or either skipped; if standardize_costing_sheet earlier reported status:'skipped' (no file uploaded), this tool still runs but simply matches zero rows.

fresh_state_parameters: cbom_db.cbom rows for this rfq_id -- REQUIRED precondition (enrichment.py's _require_cbom_rows()); raises ValueError otherwise
input_db.costing_sheet rows for this rfq_id -- may be empty if no Costing Sheet was ever uploaded (an accepted, non-error state)

a_automation.action_step: BEGIN TRANSACTION; enrichment.enrich_costing_sheet(con, rfq_id) executes UPDATE statements filling _costing columns; COMMIT on success, ROLLBACK on exception.
a_automation.acceptance_check: No exception raised -- rows_matched_costing (COUNT of rows with price_original_costing IS NOT NULL) is reported but is not itself a pass/fail gate; 0 matched rows (no Costing Sheet uploaded) is still a 'success' response.

t_tech_stack.action_tool: enrich_costing_sheet (this tool itself, delegating to reporting_pipeline.run_costing_enrichment -> enrichment.enrich_costing_sheet)
t_tech_stack.fixed_check_tool: None -- no independent validation MCP tool exists; the cbom-rows precondition is inline SQL in enrichment.py's _require_cbom_rows().

v_variables.success_gate: enrich_costing_sheet() completes without raising -- transaction commits regardless of rows_matched_costing count
v_variables.no_op_condition: No idempotent already-processed short-circuit exists -- every call re-runs the UPDATE statements; if input_db.costing_sheet has zero rows for this rfq_id, the effective outcome is a no-op (rows_matched_costing==0) but the call itself always executes
v_variables.escalation_condition: None -- this tool never sets hitl:1
v_variables.budget_limit: 300s MCP Jungle call_tool() timeout / 600s Dify HTTP node timeout

json_schema.rows_matched_costing: integer (COUNT of rows with price_original_costing IS NOT NULL)
